crates.description: Real-time audio DSP for CFA4: BS.1770 / EBU R128 loudness metering and audio effects
CFA4 headless CLI and MCP server
CFA4 engine façade: session, command registry, history, media pool
Export pipeline: parallel render → encode → mux, presets, progress/cancel

FFmpeg (>= 9.0.2) supplementary media backend for CFA4 (layer L5): probes the FFmpeg the build links, opens media the Rust engine cannot open and decodes it at its native bit depth, as a fallback behind the own engine (ADR 0005)
Video frames and audio buffers with explicit colour metadata
Golden-image tests for the CPU renderer/compositor and GPU-vs-CPU parity (test-only crate)
wgpu compositor: YUV/RGB layer sampling, linear-light premultiplied compositing in WGSL
Optional GStreamer backend for CFA4 (layer L5): probes the system's GStreamer installation and reads media information through it, as a supplement to the Rust media engine
Media sources: probing, decoding traits, frame cache, generators, stills
CFA4 document model: projects, bins, clips, sequences, tracks, effects, keyframes, markers
CFA4 media quality control (layer L3): versioned QC report schema, QC profiles with thresholds, file hashing, verdicts that never pass a skipped or missing mandatory check
Sequence evaluation and CPU reference compositor (linear-light premultiplied f32)
CFA4 compute router (layer L1): per-task choice of GPU, NPU or CPU backend from a routing table, the device inventory and user preferences, with recorded reasons and fallback order
CFA4 Smart Cut / Smart Render planning (layer L3): media capability registry, GOP indexing and render plans for lossless packet-copy and boundary re-encode exports
Test-only helpers: ffmpeg/ffprobe and AVM (AV2) oracle discovery, fixture directories, golden-image comparison

scope.excludes: test, bench and example files; comment lines
